assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature priority is 'Critical' (from feature-multi-repo.md). Impact map documents: 'Priority: Critical (will be propagated to all created tasks and epics)' and additional_fields includes '"priority": {"name": "Critical"}'. Summary-comment.md confirms: 'Priority | Critical | Propagated to all created tasks and epics — Feature has priority set (not "Undefined")'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature fixVersions is 'RHTPA 1.5.0' (from feature-multi-repo.md). No fixVersion scope config in CLAUDE.md, defaulting to 'both'. Impact map documents: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (will be propagated to all created tasks and epics; no fixVersion scope setting found in Jira Field Defaults — defaults to "both")' and additional_fields includes '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'. Summary-comment.md confirms: 'Fix Versions | RHTPA 1.5.0 | Propagated to all created tasks and epics — Feature has fixVersions set; no fixVersion scope setting in Jira Field Defaults (defaults to "both")'.
